notes.title: Game Update! Doors!
notes.content:
A new option to speed up door animations has been added to the menu. You can enable it if you want the door animations to play faster.

Fixed a bug where puppet deaths did not affect the ending.

notes.title: New English translation!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44265909/c4b4650440ce6509d6296c89ac8e4cbe7b1181df.png
New translation of the game prepared together with ParadiseHotel51. 

Paradisehotel51 will help me to prepare a new version of English translation of Mind Control: Bloody Renaissance. New better translation will make the game available for more players! At the moment is ready to update the translation for the demo version, which I will add in the next update. If you haven't played the game yet, I recommend you to do it right after the update! At the moment the game is technically ready and is at the post-production stage. We are polishing and searching for bugs as well as translating the game into English. Follow the game in our social networks and add the game to your wishlist. I will be very grateful to you if you tell your friends about the game.

Many thanks to ParadiseHotel51 for your help with the translation!
